node.title: Why does my get_max_index function return zero? (High Water Mark Algorithm)
node.author: hghosh
node.doctext:
Hello, monks! I've written a simple function that should return the index of the maximum value in an array. However, it will always return $imax=0. No matter how hard I look, I can't tell where my logic is flawed. I suspect the fix is embarrassingly straightforward; thank you so much for your help!

use strict; use warnings; sub get_max_index { #revisit how to define functions/"my" var ? (default parameters?) my $imax=0; for (my $i=0; $i<@_; $i++) { my $imax=$i if ($_[$imax]<=$_[$i]);} return $imax; } my @arr = (1..10); my $ans = get_max_index(@arr); print"$ans\n";
